notes: «أبو إسحاق» is a bare kunya, written as it stands and not identified (rule 3)
«قال سمعت البراء بن عازب يحدث» — Abu Ishaq heard Bara, whose own account is the saying: last link (rules 5, 6)
The long battle narrative names many speakers (Abu Sufyan, Umar, the Companions): they are in the scene, not links
